answer_result.answer: Dave aims to keep learning auto engineering and someday build a custom car from scratch; he also uses his passion for cars to work in the field (opened a car maintenance shop, teamed with a local garage, works on restorations) and shares it with others through a car-mod blog to inspire/help them.

question.question: What does Dave aim to do with his passion for cars?

- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or something else); Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and that working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too, and he shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a band playing on stage with lights on. Dave: "Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!" The conversation closed with Dave telling Calvin to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and to "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!", and Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" (Calvin's goal details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16].
- On 2023-07-21, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we spoke!"): told him about his recent road trip with friends and shared a photo of a motorcycle on a dirt road (details in ## Road trip (2023-07-21)); Calvin told him about the recording-studio project in his Japanese mansion and shared a progress photo, and Dave marveled at the progress, said it must be very fulfilling to have his own space, and asked about the challenges of Calvin experimenting with genres and moving between styles (details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S11T1][S11T3][S11T4][S11T5][S11T7].
- The 2023-07-21 conversation continued: Dave asked how Calvin deals with the pressure of his music and stays motivated; Calvin said collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy helps; Dave encouraged him — surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating "will give you a boost", "You've achieved so much so far; keep going, buddy!" (Calvin's motivation details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S11T9][S11T10][S11T11].
- The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! Keep pushing yourself and never lose sight of your goals. I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin said "Thanks, Dave! Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- On 2023-08-11, caught up with Calvin ("been ages!"): Dave announced he got picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and to work on building a custom car) and shared photos of the cars he's working with (a man in front of a car on a lift; a mechanic working on a car; a silver Corvette) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)). Calvin congratulated him and asked about the transformations he'd done so far and how the current project is going, and praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T1][S13T2][S13T3][S13T5][S13T6][S13T7][S13T8].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Dave said his current project combines "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", that he's "really happy with it", that the small details are what "make it unique and personalized", and that customizing it is "like a work of art on wheels" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin praised his attention to detail and encouraged him to keep coming up with new cool stuff [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14]. Dave then offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in ## Music); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment", and will keep the offer in mind — "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave telling Calvin "No worries... Got it. Good luck with your music!"; Calvin thanked him for the encouragement and said he'll keep working hard and making music, and Dave signed off "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later." [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].
